name: YITA Dynamics
name_zh: 深圳伊塔动力科技有限公司
summary: YITA Dynamics is a Shenzhen developer of integrated joint modules and force-controlled robotic systems. Its C-series modules combine transmission, drive control and feedback for humanoid robots and industrial automation. The official named component portfolio comprises five joint sizes with through-bores, dual absolute encoders, EtherCAT and CAN FD communication.
